Convert a NIS file to annual Parquet

Source: R/convert.R
nis_convert.Rd

Convert a NIS file to annual Parquet

Usage

nis_convert(path, dir, encoding = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path to one annual NIS Stata (.dta), SAS (.sas7bdat), or SPSS (.sav) file with a numeric YEAR column, or one HCUP fixed-width NIS_<year>_Core.ASC file from 2012 through 2024.

dir

Existing directory in which to create NIS_<year>.parquet/.

encoding

Source encoding override passed to haven. The default uses the reader's format-specific encoding. Use "latin1" for a legacy Stata file known to use Latin-1.

Value

The path of the annual Parquet directory, invisibly.

Details

Conversion reads bounded batches and writes zstd-compressed Parquet parts in source order. All records must have the same year, which must agree with the year in filenames starting with NIS_<year>. Invalid UTF-8 or malformed ICD slot values stop conversion. Blank codes and HCUP's invl and incn codes are accepted.

Populated code slots must match the release's coding era. For 2015, provide the discharge quarter or the corresponding diagnosis and procedure version column. Later SAS and SPSS batches can require rescanning the source from the beginning. This keeps memory bounded but increases conversion time as the file grows.

Native Core files use HCUP's published SAS layouts, including the 2019 and 2020 V2 layouts. HCUP numeric missing codes become Parquet nulls. Character fields lose their right padding and blank fields become nulls. Use a consistent LF or CRLF line ending throughout the file. The 2015 native Core file contains no diagnosis or procedure slots. The Core converter does not join the separate 2015 diagnosis and procedure groups or other supplementary HCUP files.

The annual directory is published after validation and is never overwritten. nis_open() checks converted data against the HCUP annual release statistics by default.

See also

Other data-access: nis_example(), nis_label(), nis_open()

Examples

if (requireNamespace("haven", quietly = TRUE)) {
  dir <- tempfile()
  dir.create(dir)
  path <- file.path(dir, "NIS_2020.dta")
  haven::write_dta(data.frame(YEAR = 2020L, I10_DX1 = "I509"), path)
  nis_convert(path, dir)
  nis_open(dir, check_release = FALSE)
}
